title: UY8 Create+
description: A big mod pack focused on create with addons for create and farmers delight. The modpack also includes mods like tectonic, geophilic, and vanilla backported for world gen with structure mod across all three dimensions.
body:
This modpack has a large focus on the vanilla+ feel with the Create mod and various addons for it.

Create addons: Create Aeronautics, Create Enchantment Industry, Create Crafts & Additions, Create Stuff N Additions, Create Connected, Create Encased, Create Slice & Dice, Create Central Kitchen, Steam n Rails Neoforge, and more. 

Vanilla+ mods: Vanilla Backported, Farmers Delight, and more.

World gen, and overhaul mods:
Overworld: Tectonic, Geophilic
Nether: Amplified Nether, Amplified Nether Height
End: Nullscape
With numerous structure mods across all three dimensions.
